name: Agora Dollar
oneLiner: AUSD is Agora's centralized dollar stablecoin, redeemable 1:1 and backed by cash, short-dated U.S. Treasury bills, and overnight repos managed by VanEck.
collateral: Cash (USD deposits), short-dated U.S. Treasury bills, and overnight reverse repurchase agreements; managed by VanEck in a bankruptcy-remote Delaware Statutory Trust custodied by State Street
pegMechanism: Fiat-backed 1:1; users deposit USD and mint AUSD at par; direct redemption for USD through Agora; reserves held in bankruptcy-remote Delaware Statutory Trust administered by State Street

sources.label: Grant Thornton Agora Dollar Reserve Report - May 31, 2026

applicabilityBasis.summary: AUSD is a fiat-backed U.S. dollar stablecoin with 1:1 redemption, reserve attestations, and institutional payment and settlement use cases.

genius.licensingRegulator: BMA (current); OCC national trust bank application for Agora National Trust Bank (filed 2026-04-20, under review)
genius.notes: Agora filed its OCC national trust bank charter application on April 20, 2026 (received by OCC; public portion available as PDF on OCC licensing page), pursuing the federal-qualified-nonbank pathway under GENIUS Act. CEO Nick van Eck confirmed in April 2026 that the OCC trust charter is Agora's intended GENIUS Act onshore PPSI pathway. No PPSI approval has been granted — GENIUS Act rulemaking is still in proposed-rules phase as of 2026-06-18. No registered foreign-issuer exception found. Application status: under review (not approved).

negativeEvidenceReview.summary: Agora's OCC national trust bank charter application (received 2026-04-20) is under review with no approval granted. No GENIUS Act PPSI approval, state-qualified approval, or registered foreign-issuer exception was found for AUSD. GENIUS Act rulemaking remains in proposed-rules phase with no PPSI approvals issued to any issuer as of 2026-06-18.

mintAuthority.summary: AUSD uses rate-limited EVM minter and bridge-minter roles plus a Solana Token-2022 mint authority. Agora EOAs separately hold EVM role-administration, rate-limit management, and custom transparent-proxy upgrade authority; no multisig was found on these reviewed paths.

controls.label: AUSD EVM MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.capDescription: The current rolling mint-rate-limit getter reported 15,000,000 AUSD available for this minter at the observation block; the minter cannot change its own rate limit.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324, getMinterRoleMembers() returned only this address, getAmountCanBeMinted() returned 15,000,000 AUSD, and eth_getCode returned empty bytecode. Verified implementation source applies MintRateLimit logic to MINTER_ROLE and BRIDGE_MINTER_ROLE calls.

controls.label: AUSD EVM BRIDGE_MINTER_ROLE holder
controls.capDescription: The current rolling mint-rate-limit getter reported 10,000,000 AUSD available for this bridge minter at the observation block; the adapter cannot change its own rate limit.
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324, getBridgeMinterRoleMembers() returned only this contract and getAmountCanBeMinted() returned 10,000,000 AUSD. owner() on the bridge adapter returned EOA 0xb805ff516f02db3a2dc1791bd28d77c109b37570.

controls.label: AUSD EVM RATE_LIMIT_MANAGER_ROLE holder
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324, getRateLimitManagerRoleMembers() returned only this address and eth_getCode returned empty bytecode. Verified implementation source permits RATE_LIMIT_MANAGER_ROLE to configure minter rate limits.

controls.label: AUSD EVM role administrator and proxy-admin owner
controls.evidence: At Ethereum block 25530324, getAccessControlManagerRoleMembers() returned only this EOA. AUSD.proxyAdminAddress() returned AgoraProxyAdmin 0xb8fcc66d613e5f54ee6a425ddbf4a2fdbe4dedee, whose owner() also returned this EOA. The role can grant minter and rate-limit-manager roles; the owned ProxyAdmin can replace mint-critical implementation logic.

review.evidence: Ethereum RPC at block 25530324 enumerated one MINTER_ROLE holder, one BRIDGE_MINTER_ROLE holder, one RATE_LIMIT_MANAGER_ROLE holder, and one ACCESS_CONTROL_MANAGER_ROLE holder. The custom proxy getter and verified AgoraProxyAdmin establish the upgrade path through the same access-control EOA. The Solana Token-2022 mint authority remains the separately reviewed EARe2... account. On 2026-07-15, Agora's transparency index was rechecked and listed Grant Thornton monthly reserve attestations through May 2026. Re-verified 2026-07-17: the OCC digital-asset licensing registry still lists Agora National Trust Bank only as a pending application received 2026-04-20, so no operative prudential charter exists. The Agora Bermuda Limited Terms of Use dated 2026-05-27 state that the issuer is regulated and licensed by the Bermuda Monetary Authority under the Digital Asset Business Act 2018 with a Class F license to issue, sell, or redeem digital assets; that is a licensing/conduct regime, not a prudential-class stablecoin regime. The Grant Thornton May 2026 report examines management's assertion that the fair value of reserve assets equals or exceeds AUSD in Circulation as of both 2026-05-17 and 2026-05-31, including per-network supply reconciliation tables, which confirms periodic (monthly, dual observation dates) supply-versus-reserve reconciliation. AUSD therefore earns attestation-only supervision with periodic reconciliation, not the proposed prudential tier, and its issuer-controlled rate limits and mint roles are economically unbounded.

bridgeRouteRisk.summary: AUSD is natively issued by Agora across supported chains, with public interoperability material pointing to Wormhole NTT/AUSD0 burn-mint routing and existing on-chain review identifying an Agora-controlled bridge-minter path. Pharos treats this as issuer-native burn/mint rather than a third-party liquidity route.

protocols.note: Agora selected Wormhole NTT to unify AUSD liquidity across chains.
